column1: # Assertions whose pass depends on the host's speed. A miss on a runner below
# the reference CPU count is recorded in proof.json's host_speed_failures and
# in the README; it is never a widened local bound (docs/PROOFS.md).
# A UI row excuses exactly one thing, and only on a CI ui-e2e part whose runner
# has fewer CPUs than the row's reference: a failed outcome of the named test
# whose failure is exactly the assertion the row declares. The assertion is
#   lessThan MS                  expect(received).toBeLessThan[OrEqual](expected)
#                                with Expected MS (the bound's own timing miss)
#   visibleWithin MS LOCATOR     expect(locator).toBeVisible() on exactly LOCATOR,
#                                timed out after MS (the page never drew within
#                                the spec's own wait)
# A skip, a missing outcome, any other assertion of the same test (another
# locator's visibility included), and the same miss on a local proof all still
# fail the proof. A row counts only once the base carries it identically: a
# row a change adds, or a bound it loosens, excuses nothing. A test row
# (assertion "-") is recorded on a miss and never excused.
# Columns are TAB-separated: kind, name, member, assertion, bound (seconds),
# reference CPUs, note. kind=ui names a Playwright spec path under ui/ and the
# test's title; kind=test names a Go package and its test.
